query: SELECT mm.uid, mm.message_id, COALESCE(array_agg(k.keyword) FILTER (WHERE k.keyword IS NOT NULL), '{}') AS "flags!: Vec<String>" FROM mailbox_messages mm JOIN messages m ON m.id = mm.message_id AND m.tenant_id = mm.tenant_id LEFT JOIN message_keywords k ON k.message_id = mm.message_id AND k.tenant_id = mm.tenant_id WHERE mm.tenant_id = $1 AND mm.mailbox_id = $2 AND m.user_id = $3 GROUP BY mm.uid, mm.message_id ORDER BY mm.uid ASC
